zh:
· 兔白住进软件：点她聊天，闲着会修齿轮、推倒按钮、扑光标，动作有音效，识别时会坐在进度条上报进度。
· 新手教学：改成可搜索的「我想……」问题卡，新增时间轴、AI 修字幕、剪视频等四课。
· AI 文稿粗剪：挑剪法、试听剪口、确认剪掉三步完成，剪完也能全部还原。
· 专名与方案：重复错词一键全改，新词和人名收进方案卡，下一集自动套用。
· 更快更省：云端字幕 AI 默认不开深度思考，长视频断句重排更快。
en: Tubai now lives in the app: click her to chat, and watch her fix gears, topple buttons and pounce on your pointer with sound effects you can turn off in chat. The tutorial is now searchable question cards with four new lessons. Studio adds an AI transcript rough cut and a Terms & Schemes page that fixes repeated misspellings and carries names to the next episode. Cloud caption AI skips deep thinking by default, and long-video regrouping takes less time.
